title: Completion of a copy state
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with no work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, and let $q$ be a state. Suppose that in state $q$, on any scanned symbol and any work-tape tuple, the transition on a bit $b$ moves the input head right, emits $b$, and returns to $q$, while the transition on a blank makes no input-head movement, emits nothing, and halts. For every finite Boolean string $x$ and output string $o$, after $|x|+1$ steps from the scan configuration at position $0$ in state $q$ with output $o$, the machine is in the halted scan configuration at position $|x|$ with output $o$ followed by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ has no work tapes, uses the Boolean alphabet, and has state set containing $q$
For every input symbol and work-tape tuple, on a scanned bit $b$ the transition moves right, emits $b$, and returns to $q$
For every input symbol and work-tape tuple, on blank the transition stays in place, emits nothing, and halts
$o$ is a finite Boolean output string
